question: If the top card of my library normally has plot, may I plot it using its own plot cost or the plot cost Fblthp gives it?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you may use its own plot cost or the plot cost given to it by Fblthp.
expected.answer: If the top card of your library normally has plot, you may plot that card using its own plot cost or the plot cost given to it by Fblthp.
